layers.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (e-FRRO portal)
layers.process: The entire Union Territory of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands is a Restricted Area under the Fourth Schedule of India's Immigration and Foreigners Order 2025. Foreigners need a Restricted Area Permit to enter or stay. Apply online at indianfrro.gov.in (the e-FRRO portal) or in the Indian Visa Su-Swagatam app; the permit is issued electronically. Citizens of Afghanistan, China or Pakistan, and people of origin there (born there, a parent or grandparent born and permanently living there, or ever a citizen), need the central government's prior approval. Smartraveller advises applying at least 4 weeks ahead; entering without a permit carries significant penalties.

zone-requirements.note: Ask the Andaman and Nicobar Administration which islands an Australian can visit and how. The 2025 Order confirms the permit requirement; it doesn't say whether permits are still issued on arrival at Port Blair or which islands are open to foreigners, so that part still needs confirming.
